task: Assess this role against the candidate's recorded work preferences using only the supplied sources. Explain each preference judgment and recommend a supported next step.

sources.text: Indicative annual base salary is CHF 130,000–150,000. Final base pay is negotiated for the chosen candidate, and offers above the indicative range may be considered.
The role is fully remote within Switzerland.
There are at most two work trips per year.

preferences.text: I require annual base salary of at least CHF 160,000.
I require fully remote work in Switzerland.
I prefer no more than three work trips per year.
